title: OutputMap
description: Per-LED 3D map produced by the reconstruction pipeline. See design doc §7.5.

frame.description: Coordinate frame for LED positions. 'webxr_session_ref': the WebXR session reference space of the capture (pose-trusting solver). 'gravity_leveled': the visual-inertial solver's gauge — metric, -Y aligned with measured gravity, origin/yaw arbitrary (the map is level by construction).

ledCount.description: Total LEDs in the fixture, including any that were not mapped.

unmapped.description: LED indices that were not solved (no observations or insufficient parallax).

trajectory.description: OPTIONAL solved camera path (decimated camera centers, chronological), present for visual-inertial solves — same frame as `leds`. Enables the result viewport's trajectory overlay.

rmsReprojPxGlobal.description: RMS reprojection error across all observations, in pixels.

medianParallaxDeg.description: Median per-LED maximum parallax angle, in degrees.

xyz.description: 3D position [x, y, z] in meters, WebXR session reference frame.

nViews.description: Number of observations used in the solve.

rmsReprojPx.description: Per-LED RMS reprojection error, in pixels.

parallaxDeg.description: Maximum angle between any two observation rays, in degrees.
